data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart wrapper for the browser FingerprintJS library. Allows generating a browser fingerprint hash in Dart web applications.
use_when: You need browser fingerprinting in a Flutter Web or Dart web application
You want a simple hash representation of the user's browser environment
avoid_when: You are building for mobile or desktop native platforms
You require advanced device info packages not tied to browser fingerprinting
strengths: Easy to use with a simple async API
weaknesses: Requires manually including an external JavaScript script tag in index.html
data.setup_notes: Add the FingerprintJS script tag in index.html before importing main.dart.js.
